title: Walk the Chain
statement:
A linked list is stored in `n` numbered nodes. Node `i` holds the value `v_i` and points to node `nxt_i` (`0` means there is no next node). The list starts at node `head` and passes through all `n` nodes exactly once.

Walk the list from the head. If the values in walking order are `x_1, x_2, ..., x_n`, print `(1*x_1 + 2*x_2 + ... + n*x_n) mod 1000000007`.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `head`. The second line contains `v_1 ... v_n`. The third line contains `nxt_1 ... nxt_n`.

## Output
Print the value described above.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 13000`
- `0 <= v_i <= 10^6`
